canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; sort_keys=true, separators=comma/colon, ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false; event received_at is deliberately not a publisher economic-record field
digest: SHA-256 of canonical full economic event record, plus ordered event identities in signed manifest
signature: Ed25519 over domain prefix identity-reference-research-v1 followed by NUL then canonical manifest bytes; exactly one signature
trust_context: Caller supplies independently selected scope, revision, previous digest, manifest digest, active key epoch and authorized public key; none may be learned from the candidate envelope. Here all contexts are controlled LAB facts, not real externally authenticated facts.
revisions: Positive integer strings; revision1 has null predecessor; later revisions require trusted predecessor hash and separately selected current manifest hash. Same revision different body, rollback and stale pins reject.
key_lifecycle: New reference verification requires current epoch and active authorized key. Retired/revoked keys cannot authorize new checks. Prior accepted decision bytes remain historical; their preservation does not newly authorize anything. Revocation source itself is LAB policy here.
numeric_identity: Event IDs remain exact strings; no JS Number or float coercion. Position and revision are canonical positive integer strings bounded by 2^63-1.
new_costs: Complete ordered event identity and content digest list
